title: Embodied First Exam
summary: Coding agents have passed many exams in the digital world. What is their first exam before entering the physical world? What the exam is, how eight coding agents do on its core set in three settings, and four findings on where they fail.

title: Claude Fable 5.2
summary: Claude Fable 5.2 leads every setting of the exam. Its lead over GPT-6 Astra comes from the Standard Setting, it keeps more of its Privileged successes, and it costs about half as much per attempt; three runs side by side.
